sentences.zh: 長興四年春正月戊寅朔，帝御明堂殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Changxing, spring, first month, wuyin new moon: the Emperor took the Bright Hall palace to receive court congratulations; guards and retinue were as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin new moon of the first month in spring of Changxing 4 Mingzong received New Year congratulations at the Bright Hall with full ceremonial guard.

sentences.zh: 是日雪盈尺。

translations.literal: That day snow piled to a full foot.
translations.idiomatic: That day snow fell to a depth of a full foot.

sentences.zh: 戊子，秦王從榮加守尚書令、兼侍中，依前河南尹，判六軍諸衛事。

translations.literal: On wuzi the Prince of Qin Congrong was additionally appointed acting Director of the Imperial Secretariat and concurrent Palace Attendant, retaining his former post as Henan prefect, and assigned to oversee the Six Armies and various guards.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the Prince of Qin, Congrong, was named acting Director of the Imperial Secretariat and concurrent Palace Attendant, continued as Henan prefect, and given charge of the Six Armies and the palace guards.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以端明殿學士、尚書兵部侍郎劉煦為中書侍郎、平章事。

translations.literal: On gengyin Duanming Hall academician and Vice Minister of War in the Ministry of Rites Liu Xu was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Liu Xu, academician of the Duanming Hall and Vice Minister of War, became Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 甲午，正衙命使冊故福慶長公主孟氏為晉國雍順長公主，遣太常卿崔居儉赴西川行冊禮。

translations.literal: On jiawu an envoy from the main court was ordered to ennoble the late Princess of Fuqing, Lady Meng, as Princess of Yongshun of Jin, and Director of Ceremonies Cui Jujian was sent to the Western River circuit to perform the investiture rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the court commissioned an envoy to invest the late Princess of Fuqing, Lady Meng, as Princess of Yongshun of Jin, and sent Director of Ceremonies Cui Jujian to the west to conduct the ceremony.

sentences.zh: 突厥內附。

translations.literal: The Turks submitted and came within.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks submitted to the court.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以前河東節度使李從溫為鄆州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengzi former Hedong military commissioner Li Congwen was made military commissioner of Yan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi former Hedong commissioner Li Congwen was appointed to Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑朔，帝於便殿問範延光內外見管馬數，對曰：「三萬五千匹。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the guichou new moon, the Emperor in the side hall asked Fan Yanguang how many horses were under management inside and outside the capital; he replied, "Thirty-five thousand head."
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou new moon of the second month the emperor asked Fan Yanguang in the side hall how many horses the court maintained; Fan answered, "Thirty-five thousand."

sentences.zh: 」帝歎曰：「太祖在太願，騎軍不過七千，先皇自始至終馬才及萬。

translations.literal: " The Emperor sighed and said, "When the Founding Emperor was at Taiyuan, mounted troops did not exceed seven thousand; the late emperor from beginning to end had barely ten thousand horses.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sighed: "The Founding Emperor at Taiyuan had fewer than seven thousand cavalry; my predecessor never had more than ten thousand horses in all.

sentences.zh: 今有鐵馬如是，而不能使九州混一，是吾養士練將之不至也。

translations.literal: Now we have iron horses in such numbers, yet cannot make the Nine Provinces one—this is my failure to nurture officers and train generals.
translations.idiomatic: Now we have so many war-horses and still cannot reunite the realm—it means I have not nurtured officers and trained generals well enough.

sentences.zh: 吾老矣，馬將奈何！

translations.literal: I am old; what shall be done with the horses!"
translations.idiomatic: I am old—what are we to do with all these horses?!"

sentences.zh: 」延光奏曰：「臣每思之，國家養馬太多，試計一騎士之費，可贍步軍五人，三萬五千騎抵十五萬步軍，既無所施，虛耗國力，臣恐日久難繼。

translations.literal: " Fan Yanguang memorialized, "Your servant often reflects on this: the state keeps too many horses. Roughly reckoning the cost of one cavalryman can support five infantrymen; thirty-five thousand riders equal one hundred fifty thousand foot soldiers, yet there is no use for them and state strength is wasted in vain—I fear it will be hard to sustain this over time."
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yanguang replied, "I have often thought the state keeps too many horses. One cavalryman's upkeep could feed five foot soldiers; thirty-five thousand riders equal a hundred fifty thousand infantry, yet we have no use for them and drain the treasury—I fear this cannot last."

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「誠如卿言，肥騎士而瘠吾民，何益哉！」

translations.literal: " The Emperor said, "Truly as you say—fattening horsemen while our people grow lean, what good is that!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "You are right: fattening cavalry while the people starve—what good does that do?!"

translations.literal: [Editorial supplement begins]
translations.idiomatic: [Supplement begins]

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：上問見管馬數，樞密使範延光奏：「天下常支草粟者近五萬匹。

translations.literal: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》: the Emperor asked how many horses were under management; Military Affairs Commissioner Fan Yanguang memorialized, "Those regularly drawing fodder and grain nationwide are nearly fifty thousand head."
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Five Dynasties Institutes》 records that when the emperor asked about managed horses, Fan Yanguang reported, "Nearly fifty thousand are on regular fodder and grain pay nationwide."

sentences.zh: 見今西北諸道蕃賣馬者往來如市，其郵傳之費、中估之直，日以四十五貫，以臣計之，國力十耗其七，馬無所使，財賦漸消，朝廷甚非所利。

translations.literal: At present on the northwestern circuits barbarians selling horses come and go like a market; courier costs and broker prices run to forty-five strings a day. By your servant's reckoning the state's strength is seven-tenths consumed, the horses have no use, revenues gradually drain away, and the court gains little from this."
translations.idiomatic: Nowadays frontier tribes sell horses in a steady market; courier and broker costs alone run forty-five strings a day. I reckon the state loses seven-tenths of its strength, the horses serve no purpose, revenues dwindle, and the court gains little."

sentences.zh: 」上善之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 十月，敕沿邊藩鎮，或有蕃部賣馬，可擇其良壯給券，具數以聞。）〉

translations.literal: In the tenth month an edict went to frontier military commissions: where barbarian tribes sold horses, the sturdiest might be selected, vouchers issued, and the numbers reported.)〉
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month frontier commands were told to select sturdy tribal horses sold locally, issue vouchers, and report the numbers.)〉

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以虔州節度使、檢校太尉、兼侍中馬希振為洪州節度使；

translations.literal: On disi Qianzhou military commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, and concurrent Palace Attendant Ma Xizhen was made military commissioner of Hong prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: On disi Ma Xizhen of Qianzhou, acting Grand Preceptor and Palace Attendant, was transferred to Hongzhou;

sentences.zh: 以鄂州節度使馬希廣為檢校太尉、同平章事，充桂州節度使；

translations.literal: Ezhou military commissioner Ma Xiguang was made acting Grand Preceptor and Associate Grand Councilor, filling the post of Guilin military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xiguang of Ezhou became acting Grand Preceptor, Associate Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of Guilin;

sentences.zh: 以盧州節度使兼武安軍副使姚彥章為檢校太尉、同平章事；

translations.literal: Luzhou military commissioner and deputy commissioner of the Wu'an army Yao Yanzhang was made acting Grand Preceptor and Associate Grand Councilor;
translations.idiomatic: Yao Yanzhang of Luzhou and deputy of the Wu'an army was named acting Grand Preceptor and Associate Grand Councilor;

sentences.zh: 以靜江節度副使馬希範為鄂州節度使。

translations.literal: Jingjiang deputy military commissioner Ma Xifan was made Ezhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xifan, deputy commissioner of Jingjiang, became commissioner of Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 故潞州節度使、檢校太保康君立贈太傅。

translations.literal: The late Luzhou military commissioner, acting Grand Guardian Kang Junli, was posthumously given Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: The late Luzhou commissioner Kang Junli was posthumously made Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 己未，宋州節度使安元信加兼侍中。

translations.literal: On jiwei Songzhou military commissioner An Yuanxin was additionally made concurrent Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei An Yuanxin of Songzhou was also named Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 濮州進重修河堤圖，沿河地名，曆曆可數。

translations.literal: Pu prefecture presented a map of the rebuilt river embankment; place names along the river could be counted one by one.
translations.idiomatic: Pu prefecture submitted a map of rebuilt river dikes with every place name along the bank clearly marked.

sentences.zh: 帝覽之，愀然曰：「吾佐先朝定天下，於此堤塢間小大數百戰。

translations.literal: The Emperor viewed it and, grave in manner, said, "I aided the former court in settling the realm; between these dikes and ramparts I fought hundreds of battles large and small.
translations.idiomatic: Reading it, the emperor grew somber: "I helped the previous reign conquer the realm and fought hundreds of battles along these dikes and forts.

sentences.zh: 」又指一邱曰：「此吾擐甲台也。

translations.literal: " He also pointed to a mound and said, "This is the terrace where I donned armor.
translations.idiomatic: He pointed to a mound: "That is where I once buckled on my armor.

sentences.zh: 時事如昨，奄忽一紀，令人悲歎耳！

translations.literal: Events seem like yesterday, yet in a flash a full cycle has passed—how it makes one mourn and sigh!"
translations.idiomatic: It feels like yesterday, yet twelve years have slipped by in a breath—how sad!"

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，以西川節度使孟知祥為劍南東、西兩川節度使，封蜀王。

translations.literal: On guihai Xichuan military commissioner Meng Zhixiang was made military commissioner of both eastern and western Jiannan circuits and enfeoffed as Prince of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Meng Zhixiang of Xichuan was made commissioner of both Jiannan circuits and enfeoffed as Prince of Shu.

sentences.zh: 三司奏：「當省有諸道鹽鐵轉運使衙職員都押衙、正押衙、同押衙、通引、衙前虞候、子弟，今欲列為三司職名。

translations.literal: The Three Departments memorialized: "This ministry has from the salt and iron transport commissioners of the circuits the yamen staff titles chief escort, chief escort proper, associate escort, guide, yamen frontiersman, and retainers; we now wish these listed as Three Departments posts."
translations.idiomatic: The Three Departments reported that posts such as chief escort, associate escort, guide, and yamen retainers from circuit salt-and-iron transport offices should be entered as Three Departments titles.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以御史中丞崔衍為兵部侍郎，以右諫議大夫龍敏為御史中丞。

translations.literal: On gengwu Censor-in-Chief Cui Yan was made Vice Minister of War; Right Remonstrance Grandee Long Min was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Cui Yan moved from Censor-in-Chief to Vice Minister of War, and Long Min from Right Remonstrance Grandee to Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，幸龍門。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jimao, the Emperor visited Longmen.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the third month the emperor visited Longmen.

sentences.zh: 延州節度使安從進奏，夏州節度使李仁福卒，其子彝超自稱留後。

translations.literal: Yanzhou military commissioner An Congjin memorialized that Xiazhou military commissioner Li Renfu had died and his son Yichao had styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: An Congjin of Yanzhou reported that Li Renfu of Xiazhou had died and his son Yichao had proclaimed himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲申，鎮州奏，行軍司馬趙瑰、節度判官陸浣、元從押衙高知柔等並棄市，坐受賂枉法殺人也。

translations.literal: On jiashen Zhen prefecture reported that campaigning deputy Zhao Gui, commission judge Lu Huan, original-follower escort Gao Zhirou, and others were all executed in the marketplace for taking bribes, perverting the law, and killing people.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Zhenzhou reported that Zhao Gui, Lu Huan, Gao Zhirou, and others were executed for bribery, abuse of law, and murder.

sentences.zh: 節度使李從敏罰一季俸。

translations.literal: Military commissioner Li Congmin was fined one season's salary.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Li Congmin was fined a quarter-year's salary.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以西川節度副使、知武泰軍節度兵馬留後趙季良為檢校太保、黔南節度使；

translations.literal: On yiyou Xichuan deputy military commissioner and acting military affairs commissioner of the Wutai army Zhao Jiliang was made acting Grand Guardian and Qiannan military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Zhao Jiliang, Xichuan deputy and acting Wutai commissioner, became acting Grand Guardian and military commissioner of Qiannan;

sentences.zh: 以西川諸軍馬步都指揮使、知武信軍節度兵馬留後李仁罕為檢校太傅、遂州節度使；

translations.literal: Xichuan commander of all forces horse and foot Li Renhan, acting military affairs commissioner of the Wuxin army, was made acting Grand Tutor and Suizhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Li Renhan, Xichuan commander of all forces and acting Wuxin commissioner, was named acting Grand Tutor and commissioner of Suizhou;

sentences.zh: 以西川左廂馬步指揮使、知保寧軍節度兵馬留後趙廷隱為檢校太保、閬州節度使；

translations.literal: Xichuan left-wing horse-and-foot commander and acting military affairs commissioner of the Baoning army Zhao Tingyin was made acting Grand Guardian and Langzhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Tingyin, left-wing commander and acting Baoning commissioner, became acting Grand Guardian and commissioner of Langzhou;

sentences.zh: 以西川右廂馬步都指揮使、知寧江軍兵馬留後張知業為檢校司徒、夔州節度使；

translations.literal: Xichuan right-wing horse-and-foot commander and acting military affairs commissioner of the Ningjiang army Zhang Zhiye was made acting Minister of Works and Kuizhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhiye, right-wing commander and acting Ningjiang commissioner, was made acting Minister of Works and commissioner of Kuizhou;

sentences.zh: 以西川衙內馬步都指揮使、知昭武軍兵馬留後李肇為檢校太保、利州節度使，從孟知祥之請也。

translations.literal: Xichuan inner-palace horse-and-foot commander and acting military affairs commissioner of the Zhaowu army Li Zhao was made acting Grand Guardian and Lizhou military commissioner, at Meng Zhixiang's request.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhao, inner-palace commander and acting Zhaowu commissioner, became acting Grand Guardian and commissioner of Lizhou at Meng Zhixiang's request.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，賜宰相李愚絹百匹、錢十萬、鋪陳物一十三件。

translations.literal: On bingxu the Grand Councilor Li Yu was granted one hundred bolts of silk, one hundred thousand cash, and thirteen sets of furnishings.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Grand Councilor Li Yu received a hundred bolts of silk, a hundred thousand cash, and thirteen sets of furnishings.

sentences.zh: 時愚病，帝令近臣翟光鄴宣問，所居寢室，蕭然四壁，病榻弊氈而已。

translations.literal: At the time Yu was ill; the Emperor ordered the close attendant Zhai Guangye to convey inquiries. His sleeping quarters were bare on all four walls, with only a sickbed and worn felt.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yu was then ill; the emperor sent Zhai Guangye to inquire after him and found his room utterly bare, with only a sickbed and a threadbare rug.

sentences.zh: 光鄴具言其事，故有是賜。

translations.literal: Guangye reported the matter in full, and therefore this grant was made.
translations.idiomatic: Guangye reported this, which led to the grant.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以延州節度使安從進為夏州留後，以夏州左都押衙、四州防遏使李彝超為延州留後，仍命邠州節度使藥彥稠、宮苑使安重益帥師援送從進赴鎮。

translations.literal: On wuzi Yanzhou military commissioner An Congjin was made acting commissioner of Xia prefecture; Xiazhou left chief escort and commissioner for defense of four prefectures Li Yichao was made acting commissioner of Yan prefecture; and Binzhou military commissioner Yao Yanchou and Palace Parks Commissioner An Chongyi were ordered to lead troops to escort Congjin to his post.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi An Congjin of Yanzhou was named acting Xiazhou commissioner, Li Yichao of Xiazhou acting Yanzhou commissioner, and Yao Yanchou of Bin and An Chongyi were ordered to escort Congjin to his post with troops.

sentences.zh: 以左衛上將軍盧文進為潞州節度使，以右龍武統軍張溫為雲州節度使。

translations.literal: Left Guard general Lu Wenjin was made Luzhou military commissioner; Right Dragon Martial commander Zhang Wen was made Yunzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Wenjin of the Left Guard became Luzhou commissioner, and Zhang Wen of the Right Dragon Martial became Yunzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以鳳翔行軍司馬李彥琮為鹽州防禦使。

translations.literal: On gengyin Fengxiang campaigning deputy Li Yancong was made defense commissioner of Yan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Li Yancong of Fengxiang became defense commissioner of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 時範延光等奏，請因夏州之師製置鹽州，故有是命。

translations.literal: At the time Fan Yanguang and others memorialized asking that, using the army for Xia prefecture, Yan prefecture be organized—hence this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yanguang and others had asked to establish Yanzhou while the Xiazhou campaign was underway, which led to this appointment.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以右威衛上將軍安重霸為同州節度使。

translations.literal: On guisi Right Awesome Guard general An Chongba was made Tongzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi An Chongba of the Right Awesome Guard became Tongzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以左龍武統軍符彥超為安州節度使。

translations.literal: On jihai Left Dragon Martial commander Fu Yanchao was made Anzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Fu Yanchao of the Left Dragon Martial became Anzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 詔除放京兆、秦、岐、邠、涇、延、慶、同、華、興元十州長興元年二年係欠夏秋稅物，及營田莊宅務課利，以其曾輦運供軍糧料也。

translations.literal: An edict remitted summer and autumn tax goods still owed from the first and second years of Changxing in the ten prefectures Jingzhao, Qin, Qi, Bin, Jing, Yan, Qing, Tong, Hua, and Xingyuan, as well as levies from the farm and manor offices, because they had once transported grain to supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: An edict canceled summer and autumn tax arrears from Changxing 1–2 in Jingzhao, Qin, Qi, Bin, Jing, Yan, Qing, Tong, Hua, and Xingyuan, plus farm and manor levies, because those regions had once hauled grain for the army.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，故晉國夫人夏氏追冊皇后，有司上諡曰昭懿，從之。

translations.literal: On jiachen the late Lady of Jin, Lady Xia, was posthumously ennobled as Empress; the relevant offices proposed the posthumous title Zhaoyi, and approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the late Lady of Jin, Lady Xia, was posthumously made empress with the temple name Zhaoyi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，李彝超奏：「奉詔除延州留後，已受恩命訖，三軍百姓擁隔，未遂赴任。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on wushen, Li Yichao memorialized: "Having received the edict appointing me acting commissioner of Yan prefecture, I have already accepted the gracious commission, but the three armies and the people block my way and I have been unable to take up the post."
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the fourth month of summer Li Yichao reported that although he had accepted appointment as acting Yanzhou commissioner, the troops and people were blocking him from taking office.

sentences.zh: 」帝遣閣門使蘇繼顏齎詔促彝超赴任。

translations.literal: " The Emperor sent Palace Gate Commissioner Su Jiyan bearing an edict to urge Yichao to take up his post.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Su Jiyan of the Palace Gate office with an edict ordering Yichao to proceed to his post.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以刑部侍郎劉讚為秘書監、秦王傅。

translations.literal: On guichou Vice Minister of Justice Liu Zan was made Director of the Secretariat and Tutor to the Prince of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Liu Zan, Vice Minister of Justice, became Director of the Secretariat and tutor to the Prince of Qin.

translations.literal: [Editorial supplement begins]
translations.idiomatic: [Supplement begins]

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：長興四年四月，以秘書監劉讚為秦王傅，前忠武軍節度判官蘇瓚為秦王友，前襄州觀察使魚崇遠為秦王府記室參軍。

translations.literal: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》: In the fourth month of the fourth year of Changxing, Director of the Secretariat Liu Zan was made Tutor to the Prince of Qin; former Zhongwu army commission judge Su Zan was made Companion to the Prince of Qin; former Xiangzhou observation commissioner Yu Chongyuan was made Recorder of the Prince of Qin's household.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Five Dynasties Institutes》 says in the fourth month of Changxing 4 Liu Zan became tutor to the Prince of Qin, Su Zan companion, and Yu Chongyuan recorder of the prince's household.

sentences.zh: 時言事者請為秦王置師傅，上顧問近臣，皆以秦王名勢隆盛，不敢置議，請自選擇，乃降是命。）〉

translations.literal: At the time memorialists asked that tutor and mentor be appointed for the Prince of Qin. The Emperor looked to close ministers; all said the prince's fame and power were too exalted for them to dare propose, and asked that he choose himself—whereupon these appointments were issued.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Memorialists had asked for a tutor and mentor for the prince; the emperor consulted close ministers, who said the prince's stature was too great for them to nominate anyone and asked the emperor to choose—hence these appointments.)〉

sentences.zh: 甲寅，前鄧州節度使梁漢顒以太子少師致仕，太子賓客裴皞以兵部尚書致仕。

translations.literal: On jiayin former Dengzhou military commissioner Liang Hanyong retired as Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent; Heir Apparent's Guest Pei Hao retired as Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin former Dengzhou commissioner Liang Hanyong retired as Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent, and Pei Hao as Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 戊午，追冊昭宗皇后何氏為宣穆皇后，祔饗太廟，百僚進名奉慰，廢朝三日。

translations.literal: On wuwu Empress He of Emperor Zhaozong was posthumously ennobled as Empress Xuanmu, enshrined for sacrifice in the Grand Temple; the hundred officials advanced their names in condolence; court was suspended for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Empress He of Zhaozong was posthumously honored as Empress Xuanmu and enshrined in the ancestral temple; officials offered condolences and court was suspended for three days.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以左散騎常侍任讚為戶部侍郎，以吏部侍郎藥縱之為曹州刺史。

translations.literal: On jisi Left Regular Attendant Ren Zan was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Vice Minister of Personnel Yao Zongzhi was made prefect of Cao.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Ren Zan became Vice Minister of Revenue, and Yao Zongzhi of Personnel became prefect of Cao.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，延州奏，蕃部劫掠餉運及攻城之具，守蘆關兵士退守金明鎮。

translations.literal: On guiyou Yanzhou reported that barbarian bands had plundered supply transport and siege equipment; troops guarding Luguan had withdrawn to defend Jinming garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Yanzhou reported tribal raids on supply trains and siege gear, and that Luguan garrison troops had fallen back to Jinming.

sentences.zh: 五月丙子朔，帝御文明殿受朝。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the bingzi new moon, the Emperor took the Hall of Civilization to receive court.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi new moon of the fifth month the emperor held court at the Hall of Civilization.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，皇子鳳翔節度使從珂封潞王。

translations.literal: On wuyin the imperial son Congke, military commissioner of Fengxiang, was enfeoffed as Prince of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the prince Congke of Fengxiang was enfeoffed as Prince of Lu.

sentences.zh: 新授戶部侍郎任讚改刑部侍郎，讚訴以所授官是丁憂闕，故改正。

translations.literal: The newly appointed Vice Minister of Revenue Ren Zan was changed to Vice Minister of Justice; Zan pleaded that the post he had been given was a vacancy left by mourning, and therefore the change was made.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Zan, newly named Vice Minister of Revenue, was reassigned to Vice Minister of Justice after explaining that the Revenue post had been a mourning vacancy.

sentences.zh: 皇子從益封許王，鄆州節度使李從溫封兗王，河中節度使李從璋封洋王，鎮州節度使李從敏封涇王。

translations.literal: The imperial son Congyi was enfeoffed as Prince of Xu; Yanzhou military commissioner Li Congwen as Prince of Yan; Hezhong military commissioner Li Congzhang as Prince of Yang; Zhenzhou military commissioner Li Congmin as Prince of Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Congyi became Prince of Xu; Li Congwen of Yanzhou Prince of Yan; Li Congzhang of Hezhong Prince of Yang; and Li Congmin of Zhenzhou Prince of Jing.

sentences.zh: 甲申，帝避暑於九曲池，既而登樓，風毒暴作，聖體不豫，翌日而愈。

translations.literal: On jiashen the Emperor took the cool at the Nine-Bend Pool; afterward he ascended a tower, and a violent wind affliction seized him—the sacred person was unwell, but recovered the next day.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the emperor cooled himself at the Nine-Bend Pool, then climbed a tower; a sudden wind chill left him ill, but he recovered the next day.

translations.literal: [Editorial supplement begins]
translations.idiomatic: [Supplement begins]

sentences.zh: （《北夢瑣言》云：上聖體乖和，馮道對寢膳之間，動思調衛，因指御前果實曰：「如食桃不康，翌日見李而思戒可也。

translations.literal: (The 《Miscellaneous Tales of Northern Dreams》 says: when the Emperor's sacred person was out of harmony, Feng Dao, facing him between bed and meal, often thought of regulating his health; he therefore pointed to fruit before the throne and said, "If eating peaches brings discomfort, the next day seeing plums will make one think to abstain."
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Miscellaneous Tales of Northern Dreams》 says that when the emperor was unwell, Feng Dao at his bedside thought constantly of his health and pointed to fruit before the throne: "If peaches disagree with you, seeing plums the next day should remind you to be careful."

sentences.zh: 」初，上因禦李，暴得風虛之疾，馮道不敢斥言，因奏事諷悟上意。）〉

translations.literal: " Earlier the Emperor had eaten plums and suddenly contracted a wind-deficiency illness; Feng Dao did not dare speak bluntly and so, while reporting on business, hinted to make the Emperor understand.)〉
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had fallen ill after eating plums; Feng Dao dared not say so directly and used this roundabout remark while reporting on state business.)〉

sentences.zh: 丙戌，契丹遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On bingxu the Khitan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Khitan envoys presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，安從進奏，大軍已至夏州，攻城，以其不受命也。

translations.literal: On dingyou An Congjin memorialized that the great army had reached Xia prefecture and was besieging the city because it had not accepted orders.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou An Congjin reported that the main force had reached Xiazhou and was besieging the city for refusing orders.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以靈武留後張希崇為本州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengzi acting commissioner of Lingwu Zhang Xichong was made military commissioner of that prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Zhang Xichong, acting commissioner of Lingwu, became its military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，故夏州節度使、朔方郡王李仁福追封虢王。

translations.literal: On xinchou the late Xiazhou military commissioner, Prince of Shuofang Li Renfu, was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Guo.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the late Xiazhou commissioner and Prince of Shuofang Li Renfu was posthumously made Prince of Guo.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以前晉州留後薄文為本州節度使。

translations.literal: On renyin former acting commissioner of Jin prefecture Bo Wen was made military commissioner of that prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin former acting Jinzhou commissioner Bo Wen became its military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午朔，文武百僚、宰臣馮道等拜章，請於尊號內加「廣運法天」四字，凡拜三章，詔允之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the bingwu new moon, the civil and military hundred officials and Grand Councilor Feng Dao and others submitted memorials asking that the four characters "Broad Fortune in Accord with Heaven" be added within the honorific title; they submitted three times in all, and an edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu new moon of the sixth month officials and Grand Councilor Feng Dao thrice asked to add "Broad Fortune in Accord with Heaven" to the emperor's honorific title, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 詔宮西新園宜名永芳園，其間新殿宜名和慶殿。

translations.literal: An edict said the new garden west of the palace should be named Ever-Fragrant Garden, and the new hall within it should be named Hall of Harmonious Celebration.
translations.idiomatic: The new garden west of the palace was named Ever-Fragrant Garden and its new hall the Hall of Harmonious Celebration.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，秦王從榮加食邑至萬戶，實封二千戶。

translations.literal: On bingchen the Prince of Qin Congrong's fief income was increased to ten thousand households, with two thousand actual enfeoffments.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the Prince of Qin Congrong's fief was raised to ten thousand households, with two thousand actual enfeoffments.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以右驍衛上將軍李從昶為左龍武統軍，以前邢州節度使高允韜為右龍武統軍，以右驍衛上將軍羅周敬為左羽林統軍，以右監門上將軍婁繼英為金州刺史。

translations.literal: On dingsi Right Valiant Cavalry general Li Congchang was made Left Dragon Martial commander; former Xingzhou military commissioner Gao Yuntao was made Right Dragon Martial commander; Right Valiant Cavalry general Luo Zhoujing was made Left Forest of Feathers commander; Right Gatewatch general Lou Jiying was made prefect of Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Li Congchang of the Right Valiant Cavalry became Left Dragon Martial commander; Gao Yuntao of Xingzhou Right Dragon Martial commander; Luo Zhoujing of the Right Valiant Cavalry Left Forest of Feathers commander; and Lou Jiying of the Right Gatewatch prefect of Jin.

sentences.zh: 戊午，宋王從厚加食邑至萬戶，實封一千戶。

translations.literal: On wuwu the Prince of Song Conghou's fief income was increased to ten thousand households, with one thousand actual enfeoffments.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the Prince of Song Conghou's fief was raised to ten thousand households, with one thousand actual enfeoffments.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以前涇州節度使李金全為滄州節度使。

translations.literal: On renxu former Jingzhou military commissioner Li Jinquan was made Cangzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu former Jingzhou commissioner Li Jinquan became Cangzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔御史中丞龍敏等詳定《大中統類》。

translations.literal: On guihai an edict ordered Censor-in-Chief Long Min and others to compile in detail the 《Dazhong Comprehensive Categories》.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Long Min and others were ordered to revise the 《Dazhong Comprehensive Categories》.

sentences.zh: 甲子，第十四女封壽安公主，第十五女封永樂公主。

translations.literal: On jiazi the fourteenth daughter was enfeoffed as Princess of Shou'an; the fifteenth daughter as Princess of Yongle.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the fourteenth daughter became Princess of Shou'an and the fifteenth Princess of Yongle.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以前利州節度使孫漢韶為洋州節度使。

translations.literal: On wuchen former Lizhou military commissioner Sun Hanshao was made Yangzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen former Lizhou commissioner Sun Hanshao became Yangzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬申，永寧軍節度使、容州管內觀察使、檢校太尉、兼侍中馬存加食邑實封。

translations.literal: On renshen Yongning army military commissioner, observation commissioner within Rong prefecture, acting Grand Preceptor, and concurrent Palace Attendant Ma Cun received increased fief income and actual enfeoffments.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Ma Cun of Yongning, observation commissioner of Rong, acting Grand Preceptor and Palace Attendant, received an increase in fief income and actual enfeoffments.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，帝復不豫。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the Emperor was again unwell.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the emperor fell ill again.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，以著作佐郎尹拙為左拾遺，直史館。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on dingchou, Editorial Assistant Yin Zhuo was made Left Reminder and assigned to the Historiography Office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the seventh month of autumn Yin Zhuo, editorial assistant, became Left Reminder and was assigned to the Historiography Office.

sentences.zh: 國朝舊制，皆以畿赤尉直史館，今用諫官自拙始，從監修李愚奏也。

translations.literal: By the old institution of our dynasty, all who served in the Historiography Office were capital-district magistrates; now a remonstrance official was used, beginning with Zhuo, following the memorial of supervising compiler Li Yu.
translations.idiomatic: By old custom only capital-district magistrates served in the Historiography Office; Zhuo was the first remonstrance official appointed there, at supervising compiler Li Yu's request.

sentences.zh: 己卯，東嶽三郎神贈威雄大將軍。

translations.literal: On jimao the Third Son Spirit of the Eastern Peak was given the title General of Majestic Might.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the Third Son Spirit of Mount Tai was posthumously named General of Majestic Might.

sentences.zh: 初，帝不豫，前淄州刺史劉遂清薦泰山僧一人，雲善醫，及召見，乃庸僧耳。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the Emperor was unwell, former Zi prefecture prefect Liu Suiqing recommended a Mount Tai monk, saying he was skilled in medicine; when summoned and seen, he was merely a mediocre monk.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor had first fallen ill, former Zi prefect Liu Suiqing recommended a Mount Tai monk said to be a fine physician, but on meeting him he proved an ordinary monk.

sentences.zh: 問方藥，僧曰：「不工醫，嘗於泰山中親睹嶽神，謂僧曰：『吾第三子威靈可愛，而未有爵秩，師為我請之。

translations.literal: Asked about prescriptions, the monk said, "I am not skilled in medicine. Once in Mount Tai I personally saw the Peak Spirit, who told the monk, 'My third son's majesty and spirit are lovable, yet he has no rank or title—Master, please request them for me.'"
translations.idiomatic: Asked for remedies, the monk said he was no physician but had seen the god of Mount Tai, who asked him to seek a title for his third son, whose spirit was worthy but had no rank.

sentences.zh: 』」宮中神其事，故有是命，識者嫉遂清之妖佞焉。

translations.literal: " The palace treated the matter as numinous, and therefore this appointment was made; the knowing resented Suiqing's sorcery and flattery.
translations.idiomatic: The palace took the story as miraculous and issued the appointment; the knowing blamed Suiqing for superstition and flattery.

sentences.zh: 詔應台官出行，須令人訶引，使軍巡職掌等規避。

translations.literal: An edict said that when censorial officials went out, men must be sent to call the way clear so that military patrol officers and the like would yield.
translations.idiomatic: Censorial officials traveling abroad were to have heralds clear the road so military patrols would give way.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔安從進班師，時王師攻夏州無功故也。

translations.literal: On renwu an edict ordered An Congjin to withdraw the army, because at the time the imperial forces had attacked Xia prefecture without success.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu An Congjin was ordered to withdraw because the assault on Xiazhou had failed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以許州節度使孟鵠卒廢朝，贈太傅。

translations.literal: On yiyou, because Xuzhou military commissioner Meng Hu had died, court was suspended; he was posthumously given Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou court was suspended for the death of Xuzhou commissioner Meng Hu, who was posthumously made Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 詔賜在京諸軍將校優給有差。

translations.literal: An edict granted differential generous allowances to officers of the various armies in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Officers of the capital armies received graded bonus allowances.

sentences.zh: 時帝疾未痊，軍士有流言故也。

translations.literal: At the time the Emperor's illness had not yet healed, and there was loose talk among the soldiers—hence this.
translations.idiomatic: This was because the emperor was still ill and rumors were spreading among the troops.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，兩浙節度使、檢校太傅、守中書令錢元瓘封吳王。

translations.literal: On dinghai Liangzhe military commissioner, acting Grand Tutor, and acting Director of the Secretariat Qian Yuanguan was enfeoffed as Prince of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Qian Yuanguan of Liangzhe, acting Grand Tutor and Director of the Secretariat, was enfeoffed as Prince of Wu.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申，帝被袞冕，禦明堂殿受冊，徽號曰聖明神武廣運法天文德恭孝皇帝。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on wushen, the Emperor donned the dragon robes and coronet, took the Bright Hall palace to receive the investiture; his honorific title was Sagely, Bright, Divinely Martial, of Broad Fortune in Accord with Heaven, Cultured in Virtue, and Reverently Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the eighth month the emperor, in full regalia, received his investiture at the Bright Hall as Sagely, Bright, Divinely Martial, of Broad Fortune in Accord with Heaven, Cultured in Virtue, and Reverently Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，製大赦天下，常赦所不原者咸赦除之。

translations.literal: When the rites were complete, he proclaimed a great amnesty for all under Heaven; even those normally excluded from regular amnesties were all pardoned and released.
translations.idiomatic: When the ceremony ended he proclaimed a great amnesty, pardoning even offenses normally excluded from regular amnesties.

sentences.zh: 己酉，賜侍衛諸軍優給有差。

translations.literal: On jiyou, differential generous allowances were granted to the various guards of the Imperial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the palace guards received graded bonus allowances.

sentences.zh: 時月內再有頒給，自茲府藏無餘積矣。

translations.literal: At the time there were again distributions within the month; from this point the treasury storehouses had no surplus accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: There had already been another round of payouts that month, and the treasury was now empty.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以晉州節度使薄文卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On xinhai, because Jinzhou military commissioner Bo Wen had died, court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai court was suspended for the death of Jinzhou commissioner Bo Wen.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以右龍武統軍李從昶為許州節度使。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Right Dragon Martial commander Li Congchang was made military commissioner of Xu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Li Congchang, commander of the Right Dragon Martial Guard, became commissioner of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以秘書監高輅卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On wuwu, because Director of the Secretariat Gao Luo had died, court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu court was suspended for the death of Secretariat director Gao Luo.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以太子太師致仕符習卒廢朝，贈太師。

translations.literal: On xinyou, because Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent, retired from office, Fu Xi had died, court was suspended; he was posthumously given Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou court was suspended for the death of retired Heir Apparent tutor Fu Xi, who was posthumously named Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 辛未，秦王從榮以本官充天下兵馬大元帥，加食邑萬戶，實封三千戶；

translations.literal: On xinwei, the Prince of Qin Congrong, retaining his former post, was appointed Grand Marshal of All Armies and Horses Under Heaven; his fief income was increased by ten thousand households and his actual enfeoffment by three thousand households;
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the Prince of Qin Congrong was made Grand Marshal of All Armies while keeping his existing titles, with fief income raised by ten thousand households and actual enfeoffment by three thousand;

sentences.zh: 以右羽林統軍翟璋為晉州節度使；

translations.literal: Right Feathered Forest commander Zhai Zhang was made military commissioner of Jin prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Zhai Zhang of the Right Feathered Forest Guard became Jinzhou commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以太子賓客馬鎬為戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Heir Apparent's Guest Ma Hao was made Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Heir Apparent's guest Ma Hao was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 壬申，幸至德宮。

translations.literal: On renshen, the Emperor visited the Palace of Supreme Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the emperor visited the Zhide Palace.

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌，以戶部尚書李鈴為兵部尚書，以前戶部尚書韓彥惲為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiaxu, Minister of Revenue Li Ling was made Minister of War, and former Minister of Revenue Han Yanyun was made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the ninth month Li Ling moved from Revenue to War minister, and former revenue minister Han Yanyun took Revenue.

sentences.zh: 丙子，幸至德宮。

translations.literal: On bingzi, the Emperor visited the Palace of Supreme Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the emperor again visited the Zhide Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，樞密使範延光、趙延壽並加兼侍中，依前充使。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Privy Council commissioners Fan Yanguang and Zhao Yanshou were both additionally appointed concurrent Palace Attendants and continued in their posts as commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Fan Yanguang and Zhao Yanshou were both made concurrent Palace Attendants while remaining privy commissioners.

sentences.zh: 中書奏：「元帥儀注，諸道節度使以下帶兵權者，階下具軍禮參見；

translations.literal: The Secretariat memorialized: "According to marshal ceremonial regulations, military commissioners of the various circuits and below who bear military authority shall, below the steps, observe full military rites in paying audience;
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat reported, "Under marshal protocol, circuit commissioners and other commanders with military authority should pay audience below the steps in full military ceremony;

sentences.zh: 其帶使相者，初見亦展一度公禮。

translations.literal: those who also bear the commissioner-minister title shall at the first audience also perform once the public rites.
translations.idiomatic: those who also hold commissioner-minister rank should perform the public rites once at the first audience.

sentences.zh: 天下軍務公事，元帥府行帖指揮，其判六軍諸衛事則公牒往來，其官屬軍職，委元帥府奏請。

translations.literal: For military affairs and public business under Heaven, the Marshal's Office shall issue posted orders to command; affairs concerning adjudication of the Six Armies and various guards shall be handled by official documents exchanged back and forth; staff appointments and military posts shall be entrusted to the Marshal's Office to memorialize for request.
translations.idiomatic: Military affairs nationwide would be directed by posted orders from the marshal's office; business concerning the Six Armies and guards would pass by official correspondence; staff and military appointments would be submitted through the marshal's office.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以兵部侍郎盧詹為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Vice Minister of War Lu Zhan was made Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Lu Zhan moved from War to Personnel vice minister.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，宰臣馮道加左僕射，李愚加吏部尚書，劉煦加刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Grand Councilor Feng Dao was promoted to Left Vice Director; Li Yu was promoted to Minister of Personnel; Liu Xu was promoted to Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Feng Dao became Left Vice Director, Li Yu Minister of Personnel, and Liu Xu Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 戊子，河陽節度使兼侍衛親軍都指揮使康義誠、山南西道節度使檢校太傅張虔釗並加同平章事。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Heyang military commissioner and commander of the Palace Guard's personal army Kang Yicheng, and Shannan West Circuit military commissioner and acting Grand Tutor Zhang Qianzhao were both promoted to Associate Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Heyang commissioner and palace guard commander Kang Yicheng and Shannan West commissioner Zhang Qianzhao were both made associate grand councilors.

sentences.zh: 宣徽南院使、判三司馮贇依前檢校太傅、同中書門下二品，充三司使。

translations.literal: Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat and acting director of the Three Offices Feng Yun retained acting Grand Tutor and Second Rank of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and filled the post of Three Offices commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yun of the southern palace secretariat bureau, still directing the Three Offices, kept acting Grand Tutor and Second Rank of the Secretariat and Chancellery as Three Offices commissioner.

sentences.zh: 贇亡父名章，故改平章事為同二品。

translations.literal: Yun's deceased father was named Zhang, and therefore Associate Grand Councilor was changed to Second Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Because Yun's late father had been named Zhang, the title associate grand councilor was changed to second rank of the secretariat and chancellery to avoid the taboo.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，永寧公主石氏進封魏國公主，興平公主趙氏進封齊國公主；

translations.literal: On renxu, Princess Yongning, Lady Shi, was advanced in rank to Princess of Wei; Princess Xingping, Lady Zhao, was advanced in rank to Princess of Qi;
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Princess Yongning Lady Shi was raised to Princess of Wei and Princess Xingping Lady Zhao to Princess of Qi;

sentences.zh: 皇孫重光、重哲並授銀青光祿大夫、檢校工部尚書，秦王、宋王子也。

translations.literal: The imperial grandsons Chongguang and Chongzhe were both appointed Silver-Gleam Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and acting Minister of Works—they were sons of the Princes of Qin and Song.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial grandsons Chongguang and Chongzhe, sons of the Princes of Qin and Song, were both made Silver-Gleam Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and acting Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 前洋州節度使梁漢顒以太子少傅致仕。

translations.literal: Former Yangzhou military commissioner Liang Hanyong retired as Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Former Yangzhou commissioner Liang Hanyong retired as junior tutor to the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以右龍武統軍高允韜為滑州節度使，以韶州刺史、檢校司空王萬榮為華州節度使。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Right Dragon Martial commander Gao Yuntao was made military commissioner of Hua prefecture; Shaozhou prefect and acting Minister of Works Wang Wanrong was made military commissioner of Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Gao Yuntao of the Right Dragon Martial Guard became commissioner of Huazhou, and Shaozhou prefect Wang Wanrong acting Minister of Works became commissioner of Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 萬榮，王妃之父也。

translations.literal: Wanrong was the consort's father.
translations.idiomatic: Wanrong was the consort's father.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以樞密使趙延壽為汴州節度使，以襄州節度使朱宏昭為檢校太尉、同平章事，充樞密使。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Privy Council commissioner Zhao Yanshou was made military commissioner of Bian prefecture; Xiangzhou military commissioner Zhu Hongzhao was made acting Grand Commandant, Associate Grand Councilor, and filled the post of Privy Council commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Zhao Yanshou left the privy council for Bianzhou, and Xiangzhou commissioner Zhu Hongzhao became acting grand commandant, associate grand councilor, and privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 時範延光、趙延壽相繼辭退樞密務，及朱宏昭有樞密之命，又麵辭訴，帝叱之曰：「爾輩皆欲離朕左右，怕在眼前，素養爾輩，將何用也！

translations.literal: At the time Fan Yanguang and Zhao Yanshou had successively declined the duties of the Privy Council, and when Zhu Hongzhao received the Privy Council appointment he again pleaded face-to-face to decline; the Emperor rebuked them, saying, "You all wish to leave my side—you fear being before my eyes. I have long nurtured you—of what use will you be!"
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yanguang and Zhao Yanshou had already tried to resign from the privy council in turn, and when Zhu Hongzhao received the appointment he too pleaded face-to-face to be excused. The emperor scolded them: "You all want to get away from me—you cannot bear having me before your eyes. After all I've done for you, what good are you!"

sentences.zh: 」宏昭退謝，不復敢言。

translations.literal: " Hongzhao withdrew and apologized, no longer daring to speak.
translations.idiomatic: " Hongzhao withdrew in apology and did not dare speak again.

sentences.zh: 吏部侍郎張文寶卒。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Personnel Zhang Wenbao died.
translations.idiomatic: Personnel vice minister Zhang Wenbao died.

sentences.zh: 庚子，清海軍節度使錢元璹加檢校太傅、同平章事；

translations.literal: On gengzi, Qinghai army military commissioner Qian Yuanshao was promoted to acting Grand Tutor and Associate Grand Councilor;
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Qinghai commissioner Qian Yuanshao was made acting grand tutor and associate grand councilor;

sentences.zh: 中吳、建武等軍節度使錢元尞加檢校太師、兼中書令。

translations.literal: Zhongwu and Jianwu armies military commissioner Qian Yuanliao was promoted to acting Grand Preceptor and concurrent Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongwu and Jianwu commissioner Qian Yuanliao was made acting grand preceptor and concurrent director of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 以前滑州節度使李讚華遙領虔州節度使。

translations.literal: Former Huazhou military commissioner Li Zanhua was given titular command of Ganzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Former Huazhou commissioner Li Zanhua was given titular command of Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔天下兵馬大元帥、秦王從榮班宜在宰臣之上。

translations.literal: On xinchou, an edict said that the court rank of Grand Marshal of All Armies and Horses, the Prince of Qin Congrong, should be above the Grand Councilors.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou an edict placed Grand Marshal Congrong, Prince of Qin, above the grand councilors in court rank.

translations.literal: [Editorial supplement begins]
translations.idiomatic: [Supplement begins]

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：秦王從榮加兼中書令，與宰臣分班左右定位，及為天下兵馬元帥。

translations.literal: (The Institutions of the Five Dynasties: the Prince of Qin Congrong was additionally appointed concurrent Director of the Secretariat, took position in separate ranks to left and right of the Grand Councilors, and became Grand Marshal of All Armies and Horses Under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: (The Five Dynasties Institutes says the Prince of Qin Congrong was also made concurrent director of the secretariat, stood in separate ranks to the left and right of the councilors, and became grand marshal of all armies.

sentences.zh: 敕曰：「秦王位隆將相，望重磐維，委任既崇，等威合異，班位宜在宰臣之上。」）〉

translations.literal: An edict said: "The Prince of Qin's rank towers among generals and ministers, his prestige weighs on the state's pillars; the commission is already lofty, and equal majesty should differ—his court rank should be above the Grand Councilors.")〉
translations.idiomatic: An edict read, "The Prince of Qin stands above generals and ministers, his weight anchors the realm; with so lofty a commission his ceremonial rank should differ, and his place in court should be above the councilors.")〉

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以北面行營都指揮使、易州刺史楊檀為振武軍節度使。

translations.literal: On renyin, commander-in-chief of the northern expeditionary camp and Yizhou prefect Yang Tan was made military commissioner of the Zhenwu army.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin northern camp commander and Yizhou prefect Yang Tan became Zhenwu army commissioner.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，以前同州節度使趙在禮為襄州節度使。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on bingwu, former Tongzhou military commissioner Zhao Zaili was made military commissioner of Xiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the tenth month former Tongzhou commissioner Zhao Zaili became Xiangzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以前滑州節度使張敬詢卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On dingwei, because former Huazhou military commissioner Zhang Jingxun had died, court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei court was suspended for the death of former Huazhou commissioner Zhang Jingxun.

sentences.zh: 以刑部侍郎任讚為兵部侍郎，充元帥府判官。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Justice Ren Zan was made Vice Minister of War and filled the post of marshal's office commission judge.
translations.idiomatic: Justice vice minister Ren Zan became war vice minister and commission judge of the marshal's office.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以前鳳翔節度使孫嶽為三司使。

translations.literal: On wuwu, former Fengxiang military commissioner Sun Yue was made Three Offices commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu former Fengxiang commissioner Sun Yue became Three Offices commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以樞密使範延光為鎮州節度使，以三司使馮贇為樞密使。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Privy Council commissioner Fan Yanguang was made military commissioner of Zhen prefecture; Three Offices commissioner Feng Yun was made Privy Council commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Fan Yanguang left the privy council for Zhenzhou and Feng Yun moved from the Three Offices to privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以前潞州節度使李承約為左龍武統軍；

translations.literal: On xinyou, former Luzhou military commissioner Li Chengyue was made commander of the Left Dragon Martial Guard;
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou former Luzhou commissioner Li Chengyue became commander of the Left Dragon Martial Guard;

sentences.zh: 以前威寨軍節度使王景戡為右龍武統軍；

translations.literal: former Weizhai army military commissioner Wang Jingzhan was made commander of the Right Dragon Martial Guard;
translations.idiomatic: former Weizhai commissioner Wang Jingzhan became commander of the Right Dragon Martial Guard;

sentences.zh: 以左驍衛上將軍安崇阮為左神武統軍；

translations.literal: Left Valiant Guard senior general An Chongruan was made commander of the Left Divine Martial Guard;
translations.idiomatic: Left Valiant Guard senior general An Chongruan became commander of the Left Divine Martial Guard;

sentences.zh: 以右監門上將軍高允貞為右神武統軍。

translations.literal: Right Gate Guard senior general Gao Yunzhen was made commander of the Right Divine Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Right Gate Guard senior general Gao Yunzhen became commander of the Right Divine Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以權知夏州事、檢校司空李彝超為夏州節度使、檢校司徒。

translations.literal: On renxu, acting commissioner of Xia prefecture and acting Minister of Works Li Yichao was made military commissioner of Xia prefecture and acting Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Li Yichao, acting Xiazhou commissioner and acting Minister of Works, was confirmed as Xiazhou commissioner and acting Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔在朝文武臣僚並與加恩，以受冊尊號也。

translations.literal: On bingyin, an edict granted additional favor to civil and military officials at court, because of the reception of the investiture and honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin all officials at court received bonus honors in connection with the emperor's investiture.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以前安州節度使楊漢章為兗州節度使，以前雲州節度使張敬達為徐州節度使。

translations.literal: On wuchen, former Anzhou military commissioner Yang Hanzhang was made military commissioner of Yan prefecture; former Yunzhou military commissioner Zhang Jingda was made military commissioner of Xu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen former Anzhou commissioner Yang Hanzhang became Yanzhou commissioner and former Yunzhou commissioner Zhang Jingda became Xuzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以前兗州節度使張延朗為秦州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengwu, former Yanzhou military commissioner Zhang Yanlang was made military commissioner of Qin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu former Yanzhou commissioner Zhang Yanlang became Qinzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬申，秦州節度使劉仲殷移鎮宋州。

translations.literal: On renshen, Qinzhou military commissioner Liu Zhongyin was transferred to command at Song prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Qinzhou commissioner Liu Zhongyin was transferred to Songzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，以前滄州節度使盧質為右僕射。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingzi, former Cangzhou military commissioner Lu Zhi was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the eleventh month former Cangzhou commissioner Lu Zhi became Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，改慎州懷化軍為昭化軍，升洮州為保順軍。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the Huaihua army of Shen prefecture was changed to the Zhaohua army, and Tao prefecture was elevated to the Baoshun army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the Huaihua army in Shenzhou was renamed Zhaohua, and Taozhou was elevated to the Baoshun army.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以保大軍節度使、檢校太尉鮑君福為保順軍節度、洮鄯等州觀察等使；

translations.literal: On xinsi, Baoda army military commissioner and acting Grand Commandant Bao Junfu was made military commissioner of the Baoshun army and observation commissioner of Tao, Shan, and other prefectures;
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Baoda commissioner and acting grand commandant Bao Junfu became Baoshun commissioner and observation commissioner of Tao, Shan, and neighboring prefectures;

sentences.zh: 以彰義軍節度使、檢校太尉、同平章事杜建徽為昭化軍節度、慎瑞司等州觀察使。

translations.literal: Zhangyi army military commissioner, acting Grand Commandant, and Associate Grand Councilor Du Jianhui was made military commissioner of the Zhaohua army and observation commissioner of Shen, Rui, Si, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangyi commissioner Du Jianhui, acting grand commandant and associate grand councilor, became Zhaohua commissioner and observation commissioner of Shen, Rui, Si, and neighboring prefectures.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以前汴州節度使李從嚴為鄆州節度使，以鄆州節度使李從溫為定州節度使。

translations.literal: On yiyou, former Bianzhou military commissioner Li Congyan was made military commissioner of Yan prefecture; Yanzhou military commissioner Li Congwen was made military commissioner of Ding prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou former Bianzhou commissioner Li Congyan became Yanzhou commissioner and Yanzhou commissioner Li Congwen became Dingzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，新授右僕射盧質奏：「臣忝除官，合赴省上事，若準舊例，左右僕射上事儀注所費極多，欲從權務簡，隻取尚書丞、郎上事例，止集南省屬僚及兩省官送上，亦不敢輒援往例，有費官用，自量力排比；

translations.literal: On bingxu, the newly appointed Right Vice Director Lu Zhi memorialized: "Your servant has been unworthily appointed to office and ought to go to the ministry to assume duties; if the old precedent is followed, the ceremonial regulations for the assumption of office by the Left and Right Vice Directors cost extremely much. I wish to follow expedient simplicity and take only the precedent of vice directors and bureau directors assuming office, gathering only the subordinate officials of the southern ministry and officials of the two secretariats to escort me; I also dare not lightly invoke past precedent and waste official funds, but will arrange matters according to my own means;
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the newly appointed Right Vice Director Lu Zhi memorialized, "Having received this appointment I should report to the ministry to assume office, but the old ceremony for a vice director's inauguration is enormously costly. I ask to simplify matters and follow only the precedent used for vice ministers and bureau directors, gathering just the southern ministry staff and officials of the two secretariats to escort me. I dare not invoke the full old rite and waste public funds, and will arrange what I can afford myself;

sentences.zh: 兼不敢自臣隳廢前規，他時任行舊制。

translations.literal: nor do I dare on my own account to destroy the former regulations; at another time the old system may be followed as before.
translations.idiomatic: nor do I mean by this to abolish the old rule for good—it may be restored when circumstances allow.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 戊子，帝不豫。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the Emperor was unwell.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the emperor fell ill.

sentences.zh: 己丑，大漸，自廣壽殿移居雍和殿。

translations.literal: On jichou, his condition approached death; he moved from the Hall of Broad Longevity to the Hall of Harmonious Peace.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, gravely ill, he was moved from the Guangshou Hall to the Yonghe Hall.

sentences.zh: 是夜四鼓後，帝自禦榻蹶然而興，顧謂知漏宮女曰：「今夜漏幾何？

translations.literal: That night after the fourth watch, the Emperor suddenly rose from his imperial couch and, turning, asked the palace woman who kept the clepsydra, "How many watches of the night have passed tonight?"
translations.idiomatic: That night after the fourth watch the emperor suddenly sat up on his couch and asked the palace woman keeping the water clock, "What watch is it tonight?"

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「四更。

translations.literal: " She replied, "The fourth watch.
translations.idiomatic: " She answered, "The fourth watch."

sentences.zh: 」因奏曰：「官家省事否？

translations.literal: " She then reported, "Has Your Majesty's condition eased?"
translations.idiomatic: She then asked, "Is Your Majesty feeling better?"

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「省。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said, "It has eased.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said, "Yes."

sentences.zh: 」因唾出肉片如肺者數片，便溺升餘。

translations.literal: " He then spat out several fleshy pieces like lung, and urinated more than a sheng.
translations.idiomatic: He then spat out several lung-like pieces of flesh and passed more than a sheng of urine.

sentences.zh: 六宮皆至，慶躍而奏曰：「官家今日實還魂也。

translations.literal: All of the Six Palaces arrived and, rejoicing, reported, "Your Majesty has truly returned from death today.
translations.idiomatic: The women of the inner palace all came and exclaimed in joy, "Your Majesty has truly come back from death today!"

sentences.zh: 」已進食一器，侍醫進湯膳。

translations.literal: " Food in one vessel was already brought forward, and attending physicians presented broth and meals.
translations.idiomatic: A bowl of food was brought at once, and the attending physicians served broth and a meal.

sentences.zh: 至曙，帝小康。

translations.literal: By dawn the Emperor had slightly recovered.
translations.idiomatic: By dawn the emperor had improved slightly.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，天下大元帥、守尚書令、兼侍中、秦王從榮領兵陣於天津橋，內出禁軍拒之。

translations.literal: On renchen, Grand Marshal of All Armies Under Heaven, acting Director of the Secretariat, and concurrent Palace Attendant, the Prince of Qin Congrong, led troops and formed battle lines at the Tianjin Bridge; the inner palace dispatched the forbidden army to resist him.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Grand Marshal Congrong, Prince of Qin, acting director of the secretariat and palace attendant, drew up troops at the Tianjin Bridge, and the palace sent the imperial guard to oppose him.

sentences.zh: 從榮敗奔河南府，遇害。

translations.literal: Congrong was defeated, fled to Henan prefecture, and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Congrong was defeated, fled to the Henan prefecture seat, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 帝聞之，悲駭，幾落禦榻，氣絕而蘇者再，由是不豫有加。

translations.literal: When the Emperor heard of it he was stricken with grief and shock, nearly falling from the imperial couch; he ceased breathing and revived twice, and from this his illness grew worse.
translations.idiomatic: When Mingzong heard the news he was stricken with grief and shock, nearly falling from his couch; twice he stopped breathing and came back, and from then on his illness worsened.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，馮道率百僚見帝於雍和殿，帝雨泣哽噎，曰：「吾家事若此，慚見卿等！

translations.literal: On guisi, Feng Dao led the hundred officials to see the Emperor in the Hall of Harmonious Peace; the Emperor wept in streaming tears and, choking, said, "My family's affairs have come to this—I am ashamed to face you!"
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Feng Dao led the officials to see the emperor in the Yonghe Hall. Mingzong wept aloud and said through sobs, "My family's affairs have come to this—I am ashamed to face you!"

sentences.zh: 」百僚皆泣下沾襟。

translations.literal: " All the officials wept until their tears soaked their robes.
translations.idiomatic: All the officials wept until their robes were wet with tears.

sentences.zh: 甲午，賜宰臣、樞密使禦衣玉帶，康義誠已下錦帛鞍馬有差。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Grand Councilors and Privy Council commissioners were granted imperial robes and jade belts; from Kang Yicheng downward, brocade, silk, saddles, and horses were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the grand councilors and privy commissioners received imperial robes and jade belts, and from Kang Yicheng down others received graded gifts of brocade, silk, saddles, and horses.

sentences.zh: 遣宣徽使孟漢瓊召宋王於鄴都。

translations.literal: Palace Secretariat commissioner Meng Hanqiong was dispatched to summon the Prince of Song from Yedu.
translations.idiomatic: Palace secretariat commissioner Meng Hanqiong was sent to summon the Prince of Song from Yedu.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以三司使孫嶽為亂兵所害廢朝。

translations.literal: On yiwei, because Three Offices commissioner Sun Yue had been killed by mutinous soldiers, court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei court was suspended because Three Offices commissioner Sun Yue had been killed by mutinous troops.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，敕秦王府官屬，除諮議參軍高輦已處斬外，元帥府判官、兵部侍郎任讚配武州，秘書監兼秦王傅劉讚配嵐州，河南少尹劉陟配均州，並為長流百姓，縱逢恩赦，不在放還。

translations.literal: On dingyou, an edict addressed the staff of the Prince of Qin's household: except for Advisory Aide Gao Nian, who had already been executed, marshal's office commission judge and Vice Minister of War Ren Zan was banished to Wu prefecture; Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Tutor to the Prince of Qin Liu Zan was banished to Lan prefecture; Henan vice prefect Liu Sheng was banished to Jun prefecture—all as long-exile commoners, and even if an amnesty were encountered they were not included among those released and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou an edict punished the Prince of Qin's staff: aside from advisory aide Gao Nian, already executed, marshal's commission judge and war vice minister Ren Zan was exiled to Wuzhou, secretariat director and Qin tutor Liu Zan to Lanzhou, and Henan vice prefect Liu Sheng to Junzhou—all as permanent exiles never to be released even by amnesty.

sentences.zh: 河南少尹李蕘配石州，河南府判官司徒詡配寧州，秦王友蘇瓚配萊州，記室參軍魚崇遠配慶州，河南府推官王說配隨州，並為長流百姓。

translations.literal: Henan vice prefect Li Rao was banished to Shi prefecture; Henan prefecture commission judge Sikong Xu was banished to Ning prefecture; Companion to the Prince of Qin Su Zan was banished to Lai prefecture; Recorder Yu Chongyuan was banished to Qing prefecture; Henan prefecture investigating officer Wang Yue was banished to Sui prefecture—all as long-exile commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Henan vice prefect Li Rao was exiled to Shizhou, Henan commission judge Sikong Xu to Ningzhou, Qin companion Su Zan to Laizhou, recorder Yu Chongyuan to Qingzhou, and Henan investigating officer Wang Yue to Suizhou—all as permanent exiles.

sentences.zh: 河南府推官尹諲，六軍巡官董裔、張九思，河南府巡官張沆、李潮、江文蔚並勒歸田里。

translations.literal: Henan prefecture investigating officer Yin Shen, Six Armies patrol officers Dong Yi and Zhang Jiusi, and Henan prefecture patrol officers Zhang Hang, Li Chao, and Jiang Wenwei were all ordered to return to their home districts.
translations.idiomatic: Henan investigating officer Yin Shen, Six Armies patrol officers Dong Yi and Zhang Jiusi, and Henan patrol officers Zhang Hang, Li Chao, and Jiang Wenwei were all sent home.

sentences.zh: 應長流人並除名。

translations.literal: All who were subject to long exile were also struck from the registers.
translations.idiomatic: All those exiled were also struck from the registers.

sentences.zh: 六軍判官、殿中監王居敏責授復州司馬，六軍推官郭晙責授坊州司戶，並員外置，所在馳驛發遣。

translations.literal: Six Armies commission judge and Director of the Palace Receptions Office Wang Jumin was demoted and appointed acting military aide of Fu prefecture; Six Armies investigating officer Guo Jun was demoted and appointed acting registrar of Fang prefecture—both as supernumerary appointments, and wherever they were they were dispatched post-haste by courier.
translations.idiomatic: Six Armies commission judge and palace receptions director Wang Jumin was demoted to acting military aide of Fuzhou and Six Armies investigating officer Guo Jun to acting registrar of Fangzhou, both supernumerary posts, and both were sent off at once by courier.

sentences.zh: 時宰相、樞密使共議任讚等已下罪，馮道等曰：「任讚前在班行，比與從榮無舊，除官未及月餘，便逢此禍。

translations.literal: At the time the Grand Councilors and Privy Council commissioners jointly deliberated the crimes of Ren Zan and those below; Feng Dao and others said, "Ren Zan was formerly in the court ranks and had no prior ties with Congrong; he had held office little more than a month when he met this disaster.
translations.idiomatic: The grand councilors and privy commissioners then debated the guilt of Ren Zan and the others. Feng Dao said, "Ren Zan had been in court service and had no old ties with Congrong; he had held office barely a month when this disaster struck.

sentences.zh: 王居敏、司徒詡疾病請假，將近半年，近日之事，計不同謀。

translations.literal: Wang Jumin and Sikong Xu had been on sick leave for nearly half a year; in recent affairs they surely did not plot together.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jumin and Sikong Xu had been on sick leave for nearly half a year and can hardly have joined in the recent plot.

sentences.zh: 從榮所款昵者高輦、劉陟、王說三人，昨從榮稱兵指闕之際，沿路隻與劉陟、高輦並轡耳語，至天津橋南，指日影謂諸判官曰：『明日如今，已誅王居敏矣。

translations.literal: Those with whom Congrong was intimate were the three men Gao Nian, Liu Sheng, and Wang Yue; yesterday when Congrong raised troops and marched on the palace, along the road he spoke only with Liu Sheng and Gao Nian, bridle to bridle in whispered words; when he reached the south of the Tianjin Bridge he pointed at the shadow of the sun and said to the various commission judges, "Tomorrow at this hour Wang Jumin will already have been executed."
translations.idiomatic: Congrong's intimates were Gao Nian, Liu Sheng, and Wang Yue. When he marched on the palace yesterday he rode bridle to bridle whispering only with Liu Sheng and Gao Nian, and at the south end of the Tianjin Bridge he pointed at the sun's shadow and told the commission judges, "By this hour tomorrow Wang Jumin will already be dead."

sentences.zh: 』則知其冗泛之徒，不可一例從坐。

translations.literal: ' Then one knows that the miscellaneous and undistinguished among them cannot all be punished alike by association.
translations.idiomatic: ' That shows the rest were hangers-on who should not all be punished alike.

sentences.zh: 」朱宏昭意欲盡誅任讚已下，馮贇力爭之乃已。

translations.literal: " Zhu Hongzhao wished to execute Ren Zan and those below to the last man; Feng Yun argued forcefully against it and only then did he desist.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhu Hongzhao wanted to execute Ren Zan and all the rest, but Feng Yun argued hard against it and stopped him.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，帝崩於大內之雍和殿，壽六十七。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the Emperor died in the Yonghe Hall within the inner palace; he was sixty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the emperor died in the Yonghe Hall of the inner palace at the age of sixty-seven.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯朔，遷梓宮於二儀殿，宋王從厚自鄴都至。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the guimao new moon, the coffin was moved to the Hall of the Two Principles; the Prince of Song Conghou arrived from Yedu.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao new moon of the twelfth month the coffin was moved to the Eryi Hall, and the Prince of Song Conghou arrived from Yedu.

sentences.zh: 是日發哀，百僚縞素於位，中書侍郎、平章事劉煦宣遺製，宋王從厚於柩前即皇帝位，服紀以日易月，一如舊制雲。

translations.literal: That day mourning was proclaimed; the hundred officials stood in white hemp at their posts; Secretariat Vice Director and Grand Councilor Liu Xu announced the testamentary edict; the Prince of Song Conghou took the imperial throne before the coffin; mourning was counted as days for months, just as in the old system.
translations.idiomatic: That day mourning was proclaimed. Officials stood at their posts in white hemp, councilor Liu Xu read the testamentary edict, and the Prince of Song Conghou took the throne before the coffin, observing mourning counted as days for months according to old custom.

sentences.zh: 明年四月，太常卿盧文紀上諡議曰聖智仁德欽孝皇帝，廟號明宗，宰臣馮道議請改「聖智仁德」四字，為聖德和武欽孝皇帝。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the following year, Director of Imperial Sacrifices Lu Wenji submitted a posthumous title proposal naming him Sagely, Wise, Benevolent, and Cultured, Reverently Filial Emperor, with temple name Mingzong; Grand Councilor Feng Dao proposed changing the four characters "Sagely, Wise, Benevolent, and Cultured" to Sagely, Cultured, Harmonious, and Martial, Reverently Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The following fourth month sacrifice director Lu Wenji proposed the posthumous title Sagely, Wise, Benevolent, and Cultured, Reverently Filial Emperor and the temple name Mingzong; Feng Dao proposed changing the four words "Sagely, Wise, Benevolent, and Cultured" to Sagely, Cultured, Harmonious, and Martial, Reverently Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 宰臣劉煦撰諡冊文，宰臣李愚撰哀冊文，是月二十七日葬於徽陵。

translations.literal: Grand Councilor Liu Xu composed the posthumous-title patent text; Grand Councilor Li Yu composed the lament patent text; on the twenty-seventh day of that month burial took place at Huiling.
translations.idiomatic: Grand councilor Liu Xu wrote the posthumous-title patent and Li Yu the lament patent; on the twenty-seventh of that month Mingzong was buried at Huiling.

translations.idiomatic: [Supplement begins]

sentences.zh: （《五代史補》：明宗之在位也，一日幸倉場觀納，時主者以車駕親臨，懼得罪，其較量甚輕。

translations.literal: (Supplement to the History of the Five Dynasties: while Mingzong was on the throne, one day he visited the granary depot to observe the intake of grain; at the time the manager, because the imperial carriage had come in person, feared punishment and measured the grain very lightly.
translations.idiomatic: (Supplement to the History of the Five Dynasties says that while Mingzong reigned he once visited a granary to watch grain intake; the manager, fearing punishment because the emperor had come in person, weighed the grain very lightly.

sentences.zh: 明宗因謂之曰：「且朕自省事以來，倉場給散，動經一二十年未畢，今輕量如此，其後銷折將何以償之？

translations.literal: Mingzong therefore said to him, "Moreover, since I began personally attending to affairs, granary distribution has often taken ten or twenty years to complete; now the measure is so light—when losses and shrinkage come later, how will they be made good?"
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong said to him, "Since I began taking an active hand in government, granary distributions have often taken ten or twenty years to finish. If you weigh this lightly now, how will later losses ever be made up?"

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「竭盡家產，不足則繼之以身命。

translations.literal: " He replied, "I would exhaust my family's property, and if that were not enough I would follow with my own life.
translations.idiomatic: " He answered, "I would exhaust my family's property, and if that were not enough I would pay with my life."

sentences.zh: 」明宗愴然曰：「隻聞百姓養一家，未聞一家養百姓。

translations.literal: " Mingzong said mournfully, "One has only heard of the common people supporting one household—not of one household supporting the common people.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong said sadly, "I have only ever heard of the people supporting one household—not of one household supporting the people."

sentences.zh: 今後每石加二斗耗，以備鼠雀侵蠹，謂之鼠雀耗。

translations.literal: Henceforth two dou of allowance shall be added to every shi of grain to guard against rats, sparrows, infestation, and spoilage—this is called the rat-and-sparrow allowance.
translations.idiomatic: From then on two dou were added to every shi of grain to cover loss to rats, sparrows, and pests—the "rat-and-sparrow allowance."

sentences.zh: 」倉糧加耗，自此始也。

translations.literal: " The added allowance on granary grain began from this.
translations.idiomatic: Thus began the practice of adding allowance to stored grain.

sentences.zh: 《五代史闕文》：明宗出自邊地，老於戰陳，即位之歲，年已六旬，純厚仁慈，本乎天性。

translations.literal: Lost passages of the History of the Five Dynasties: Mingzong came from the frontier regions and was seasoned in battle formations; in the year he took the throne he was already in his sixties, pure, generous, and benevolent by inborn nature.
translations.idiomatic: Lost passages of the History of the Five Dynasties: Mingzong was a frontier man, hardened by war; when he took the throne he was already past sixty, and his purity, generosity, and kindness were inborn.

sentences.zh: 每夕宮中焚香仰天禱祝云「某蕃人也，遇世亂為眾推戴，事不獲已，願上天早生聖人，與百姓為主。

translations.literal: Each evening in the palace he burned incense and prayed heavenward, saying, "I am a barbarian; meeting a chaotic age I was pushed forward by the multitude, and the matter could not be refused. May Heaven soon produce a sage to be lord for the common people."
translations.idiomatic: Every night in the palace he burned incense and prayed to Heaven: "I am a barbarian. In a time of chaos the multitude thrust me forward, and I could not refuse. May Heaven soon send a sage to rule the people."

sentences.zh: 」故天成、長興間，比歲豐登，中原無事，言於五代，粗為小康。）〉

translations.literal: " Therefore between Tiancheng and Changxing harvests were abundant year after year, the Central Plain was untroubled, and among the Five Dynasties it may be called a rough age of modest peace.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Hence between Tiancheng and Changxing the harvests were good year after year, the Central Plain was at peace, and among the Five Dynasties this was reckoned a modest age of ease.)〉

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：明宗戰伐之勳，雖高佐命，潛躍之事，本不經心。

translations.literal: The historiographer says: Mingzong's merit in battle and campaigning, though high in aiding the founding, was not what his heart had dwelt on in the matter of hidden ascent.
translations.idiomatic: The historian writes: Mingzong's military achievements, though great in service to the founding, were not what he had ever sought; the hidden path to the throne had never been his aim.

sentences.zh: 會王室之多艱，屬神器之自至，諒由天讚，匪出人謀。

translations.literal: It happened that the royal house met many hardships and the regalia of rule came to him of itself—surely this was Heaven's approval, not the plotting of men.
translations.idiomatic: When the royal house fell into hardship the regalia came to him unbidden—surely Heaven approved, not human design.

sentences.zh: 及應運以君臨，能力行於王化，政皆中道，時亦小康，近代已來，亦可宗也。

translations.literal: When he answered the age and ruled as sovereign, he was able to put royal transformation into practice; his government kept to the middle way, and the times also knew modest peace—in recent generations he may indeed be taken as a model.
translations.idiomatic: Once he answered the age and ruled, he was able to carry out true kingship; his policies held to the middle way and the times knew modest peace. In recent memory he may be counted among the exemplary rulers.

sentences.zh: 倘使重誨得房、杜之術，從榮有啟、誦之賢，則宗祧未至於危亡，載祀或期於綿遠矣。

translations.literal: If only Chonghui had possessed the arts of Fang and Du, and Congrong the worthies of Qi and Song, then the ancestral temple might not have reached danger and ruin, and the years of sacrifice might have been hoped to extend far.
translations.idiomatic: Had Chonghui possessed the skill of Fang Xuanling and Du Rong, and Congrong the virtue of Qi Que and Song Shen, the ancestral line might not have fallen into peril, and the dynasty might have endured far longer.

sentences.zh: 惜乎！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 君親可輔，臣子非才，遽泯烝嘗，良可深歎矣！

translations.literal: The ruler and father could have been aided, but the ministers and sons lacked talent; the ancestral sacrifices were suddenly extinguished—how deeply this must be lamented!
translations.idiomatic: A ruler worthy of support had ministers unworthy of the task; the ancestral rites were cut short in a moment—how deeply this deserves our grief!
